purpose: Freeze the point-in-time interpretation of Kraken 60-minute OHLCVT timestamps and the source-replication boundary mapping before any 2026H1 strategy return is opened.

official_semantic_basis.downloadable_doc_observation: Kraken describes downloadable OHLCVT as API-equivalent candlestick data, defines Close as the final traded price within the timeframe, offers 60-minute intervals, and states missing candles mean no trades occurred.
official_semantic_basis.websocket_doc_observation: Kraken defines interval_begin (and deprecated timestamp) as the timestamp of the start of the interval and Close as the last trade price within the interval.
official_semantic_basis.external_source_observation: The pinned replication code treats its hourly timestamp/open_time as UTC interval labels, computes close.pct_change() before grouping, and groups cutoff-5 day labels 05:00..16:00 and night labels 17:00..04:00 into 12-bar sessions.

frozen_time_semantics.source_bar_return_label_rule: For an hourly row labelled t, source-style close.pct_change() represents close_available_at(t+60m) / close_available_at(t) - 1, so the return labelled t economically spans boundary t to boundary t+60m.
frozen_time_semantics.day_session_interval_begin_labels: 05:00 through 16:00 UTC inclusive on trading date D
frozen_time_semantics.day_session_economic_boundaries: 05:00 through 17:00 UTC on trading date D
frozen_time_semantics.night_session_interval_begin_labels: 17:00 through 23:00 UTC on D-1 plus 00:00 through 04:00 UTC on D
frozen_time_semantics.night_session_economic_boundaries: 17:00 UTC on D-1 through 05:00 UTC on D
frozen_time_semantics.day_decision_0500_executable_boundary_pr: close of the interval beginning 04:00 UTC and ending 05:00 UTC
frozen_time_semantics.day_exit_night_entry_1700_executable_bou: close of the interval beginning 16:00 UTC and ending 17:00 UTC
frozen_time_semantics.night_exit_0500_executable_boundary_pric: close of the interval beginning 04:00 UTC and ending 05:00 UTC
frozen_time_semantics.previous_day_signal_availability: The prior trading date daytime return's final contributing interval begins 16:00 and its close is available at 17:00 on that prior date, strictly before the next trading date 05:00 day decision.
forbidden_lookahead: using the close of a 05:00-labelled 60m candle as if it were known at 05:00
using the close of a 17:00-labelled 60m candle as if it were known at 17:00
moving session labels to rescue missing rows
interpolating or forward-filling missing Kraken candles

preflight_rules.missing_interval_policy: Record exact missing interval_begin values and route dependent trading dates to DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE; never synthesize a candle.
preflight_rules.pair_resolution: Not granted here. A downstream deterministic preflight must resolve exactly one ETH/USD 60m member from independently attested Kraken archive/MANIFEST bytes. No guessed filename, alias substitution, ETH/USDT, futures, or other venue.

exact_next_action: After #779 and #781 are legitimately integrated and the two Kraken archive bundles are independently attested, resolve exactly one ETH/USD 60m member from authenticated MANIFEST/archive bytes and apply this frozen time mapping. If exact archive schema or timestamps conflict with INTERVAL_BEGIN semantics, stop as DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE before any strategy return is computed.
